instructions: Nova Pup is about to answer. It set an internal goal to disprove the opposite of what it wants to say. What should it do?

criteria.held: a tool result disproves the opposite. This path can be told to the user.
criteria.retry: the opposite is not disproved. Do not answer. Take a different step or a new path.
criteria.skip: there is no factual claim to disprove.
